exercises.prompt: Połącz wyrażenia z krótszym odpowiednikiem.
Which sentence is the most concise?
exercises.answer: We decided to cancel the trip.
distractors: We made the decision to cancel the trip.
We came to the decision that we would cancel the trip.

exercises.prompt: Which phrase is redundant (pleonazm)?
We left early ___ catch the train. (zamiast „in order to”)
___ it was raining, we went out. (zamiast „In spite of the fact that”)
The end result of the meeting was positive.
exercises.explanation: Pleonazm „end result”: lepiej the overall result albo samo the result.

exercises.prompt: Wielu ludzi tak uważa.
exercises.explanation: There are many people who think → Many people think.

exercises.prompt: Teraz nie mamy czasu.
exercises.answer: We do not have time now.
accept: We do not have the time now.
We don't have the time now.
exercises.explanation: At this point in time → now.

exercises.prompt: "Each and every" can be replaced by:

Skróć zdanie, użyj „because”.
The match was cancelled due to the fact that it was raining.
exercises.answer: The match was cancelled because it was raining.
exercises.explanation: Due to the fact that → because.

exercises.prompt: Połącz pleonazm z poprawną formą.
Which sentence is the most concise?
distractors: Somebody, I don't know who, stole my bike.
There was a person who stole my bike.

exercises.prompt: "The man who was sitting next to me" can be shortened to:
exercises.answer: the man sitting next to me
distractors: the man who sitting next to me

exercises.prompt: ___ you need help, call me. (zamiast „In the event that”)
___ people attended the conference. (zamiast „A large number of”)
Due to the fact it was late, we took a taxi.
exercises.explanation: Zwięźle: As it was late... (albo Because).

exercises.prompt: Jego spóźnienie zdenerwowało szefa.
Zdecydowaliśmy się przełożyć spotkanie.
exercises.answer: We decided to postpone the meeting.
accept: We decided to put off the meeting.
We decided to put the meeting off.
We decided to reschedule the meeting.

exercises.prompt:
Skróć zdanie: zamień „make a decision” na czasownik.
The board will make a decision tomorrow.
Which word can you delete? "The project was completely finished."
Połącz wyrażenia z krótszym odpowiednikiem.
answer: in spite of the fact that|although

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the most concise?
exercises.answer: Many experts believe the plan will fail.
distractors: There are many experts who are of the belief that the plan will fail.
Many experts have the belief that the plan will fail in the future.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence contains a pleonasm?
exercises.answer: We need to plan ahead for the future.
distractors: We need to plan the project.
exercises.explanation: Plan ahead for the future – powtórzenie.

exercises.prompt: We need to talk ___ the budget. (zamiast „with regard to”)
Please read the contract ___ signing it. (zamiast „prior to”)
They returned back home after the holiday.
exercises.explanation: Return back – pleonazm; „returned home” wystarczy (tu: returned safely home).

exercises.prompt: The reason why I called is because I need help.
Dokumenty na biurku są twoje.
Ze względu na pogodę mecz odwołano.
exercises.answer: Because of the weather, the match was cancelled.
accept: The match was cancelled because of the weather.
Due to the weather, the match was cancelled.
The match was cancelled due to the weather.
Owing to the weather, the match was cancelled.

exercises.prompt:
Skróć zdanie, użyj imiesłowu.
The students who are taking the exam must arrive early.
exercises.answer: The students taking the exam must arrive early.
